knowledge_chunks.text: In commercial finance and retail banking, debt-to-income (DTI) ratios must remain below 36% for prime loan approvals. Net interest margins typically benchmark between 2.8% and 3.8%. A healthy portfolio maintains non-performing loan (NPL) rates below 2.5%, with fraud contamination kept strictly under 0.15%.

Financial transaction anomalies exceeding 1.0% require immediate AML (Anti-Money Laundering) triage. Key risk archetypes include: (1) Rapid Structuring (repeated transfers just below reporting thresholds), (2) Velocity Surges (multiple cross-border card authorizations in minutes), and (3) Inactive Account Reactivations with sudden high-ticket withdrawals.

In credit risk modeling, strong inverse correlation between Credit Score and Default Likelihood is standard. When loan balance correlates strongly with late fee frequency, it indicates liquidity distress in borrowers, requiring proactive loan restructuring before 90-day delinquency.

Priority Financial Governance Plan: (1) Deploy real-time rule engines for transaction velocity and geo-mismatch detection; (2) Implement dynamic risk-based pricing where borrower interest rate adjusts to leverage ratio; (3) Re-underwrite or require collateral enhancements on credit lines exhibiting high utilization with zero principal paydowns.
